name: @hdsp/connector-tray
description: ZoeConnect Connector Manager -- system tray launcher (Task #103, 2026-07-22). A tiny, separate process from the Connector Windows Service -- see README.md's 'Why a separate process' section for why this MUST NOT be merged into the Service (Windows Session 0 isolation: a service has no desktop to show a tray icon in). Talks to the Service's local REST API over 127.0.0.1 for every action; never touches Oracle, the cloud, or credentials directly.

pkg.//: systray2 ships its own prebuilt per-platform tray helper binaries under node_modules/systray2/traybin/ (tray_windows_release.exe etc, resolved via getTrayBinPath() in systray2's index.js relative to __dirname) -- these MUST be included in the pkg bundle or the tray will fail to find its helper at runtime on the target machine. NOTE (2026-07-22): this package was originally specified as 'node-systray-v2', which does not exist on the npm registry (confirmed via a real `npm install` 404 on Windows) -- 'systray2' is the actual published, maintained package; verified its traybin/ asset path directly against the published package's source before this fix, not assumed.
